THE CHATG METHOD

ChatGPT + Gemini AI: my personal creative workflow for combining AI tools with human creative judgment.

01
ChatGPT

Concept Development

Brainstorm ideas, interpret the creative brief, explore thumbnail directions, and prepare detailed prompts.

02
Gemini AI

Visual Generation

Use the prepared prompts and references to generate or refine visual concepts.

03
Human Judgment

Creative Direction

Review composition, expressions, focal points, contrast, and alignment with the client's requirements.

04
Feedback loop

Guided Refinement

Adjust prompts and creative direction based on references, feedback, and project goals.

05
Quality check

Final Review

Check clarity, composition, visual consistency, and suitability for the intended video before presenting the design.

AI helps me explore possibilities. Creative direction helps me turn them into purposeful designs.

CHATG is my own workflow, not an industry standard or certified methodology.
